verdict: Organic signals fading across all three entities; paid channels remain dark.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all paid advertising was inactive for the full 28-day period, meaning every inquiry your businesses received came entirely from Google Business Profile and organic search. Combined GBP activity totalled 401 actions this period — including 27 calls, 251 direction requests, and 123 website clicks — but that organic signal is softening, with GBP actions down 57%, 39%, and 50% week-over-week respectively across the three entities. The likely cause is reduced organic search visibility, which we are actively investigating with a root-cause review due by August 31. Website session tracking is also being repaired, so web traffic figures currently under-report true visitor volume; that fix is also targeted for this month.
